note: Market accessories. Each accessory is drawn once per avatar and pose (folder <item>/<avatar>_<pose>/), as square transparent PNG layers on that pose's 1000px canvas. The app pairs the chosen item with the avatar and pose being drawn (JJ-059-C). If an item has no art for that avatar and pose it is hidden there, never drawn wrong. released:false = wired in but NOT wearable yet; flip to true when the item goes on sale in the Market. Item names are working names until Erika names them.
